entries.what: Isabel walks to Flats High, sits through AP Calc and APUSH, and checks Nadia's yearbook planning board where the fall sports spread deadline is posted.
entries.outcome: Nadia's yearbook deadline of Nov 3 is noted on the board.

entries.what: After school she works at the library homework center on her AP Lang reading, then checks her SAT practice sections with a kitchen timer.
Dishes after dinner, then checks that Lola Cora took her lunch pills and insulin routine on Ramón's shift day.
entries.outcome: Lola Cora grumbles but is fine.

entries.what: Tuesday robotics in room C7 from 3:30 to 6, working on the drivetrain with Lucas, who keeps one-upping her design ideas.
Grace gives her a ride home after robotics and complains about the hospital charting news she heard on the radio; Isabel answers in one-word sarcasm.
Late night on the old desktop, she skims essay draft 4 and moves a few commas.
entries.outcome: Closes the file, asleep near 1 a.m.

entries.what: School day: AP Chem with Mr. Ostrowski, lunch with Nadia comparing UC and snow-school lists.
Wednesday tutoring session with Mateo at Kessler Middle, fractions with pizza drawings; he says he's just dumb at math and she picks careful encouraging words to answer him.
entries.outcome: Mateo finishes the page and smiles; she earns $20.

entries.what: Evening at home with Lola Cora's teleserye blaring at 8; Isabel does dishes and studies in her room.
Thursday robotics again in C7; Lucas talks about his early college plans and Isabel realizes she keeps noticing his laugh.
entries.outcome: She quietly files away a crush she won't admit to.

entries.what: Walks home past Plaza Marisol and picks up a jasmine milk tea at Cloud Nine, 30% sugar, no ice.
Midnight reading for APUSH in bed, the film score playing low.
Classes, then Friday lunch where Nadia plans what to wear to the street fair and asks Isabel to help with yearbook photos.
entries.outcome: They agree to go together Saturday.

entries.what: Ms. Lugo reads one of her essay paragraphs in her Friday slot and says the voice is strong.
entries.outcome: Isabel pockets the feedback without sharing the full draft.

entries.what: Quiet evening at home; Ramón is off shift and talks about the Bronco carburetor while she half-listens.
Saturday morning SAT prep with Harper at the library, timing sections with the kitchen timer.
Afternoon at the Calle Ortega Street Fair with Nadia, taking yearbook photos and eating from food stalls near Taquería Colima and Panadería Las Hermanas.
entries.outcome: They lose track of time among the music and string lights.

entries.what: Nadia drives them home and Isabel walks in at 11:20 p.m., past her 10 p.m. curfew; Grace is waiting in the kitchen and says they will talk tomorrow.
Sunday after Tagalog Mass Grace announces Isabel's weekend curfew is now 9 p.m.; Isabel storms off and Lola Cora's sinigang simmers on the stove.
Later she writes a furious vent to the assistant about the curfew, then asks how to explain her SAT plan to Grace so she will actually listen.
entries.outcome: Drafts a short SAT-plan pitch for Grace.

entries.what: Eats sinigang at dinner with the family, quietly silent, then does dishes.
